firmographics.name: Ledgerflow
firmographics.description: Embedded payments and double-entry ledger APIs for vertical SaaS platforms.

documents.title: About Ledgerflow
documents.snippet: Ledgerflow is a 340-person fintech providing embedded payments and double-entry ledger APIs to vertical SaaS platforms.
documents.body: Ledgerflow provides embedded payments and double-entry ledger APIs that vertical SaaS platforms use to move and reconcile money. The company employs 340 people and is based in New York with a hybrid work model.

documents.title: Ledgerflow raises $48M Series B
documents.snippet: Ledgerflow raised a $48M Series B led by Andreessen Horowitz in January 2026.
documents.body: Ledgerflow announced a $48M Series B led by Andreessen Horowitz in January 2026, to be used for product expansion and growing its revenue team.

documents.title: Launching real-time reconciliation
documents.snippet: Ledgerflow launched a real-time reconciliation product in May 2026 aimed at customer finance teams.
documents.body: In May 2026 Ledgerflow launched a real-time reconciliation product. The launch broadens the buyer set beyond engineering to include finance and operations leaders at customer companies.

documents.title: Careers — Ledgerflow
documents.snippet: Ledgerflow recently hired its first VP of Revenue Operations and is expanding its revenue team.
documents.body: Ledgerflow recently hired its first VP of Revenue Operations and lists multiple open roles across sales and customer success, signaling a build-out of its go-to-market function.

documents.title: Our data stack
documents.snippet: Ledgerflow runs its data stack on BigQuery and dbt.
documents.body: Ledgerflow's engineering team details running analytics on BigQuery with dbt for transformations, consolidating product and billing data for internal reporting.
